settings.label: Enabled
settings.description:
Shows Plex on the main menu
Needs a Plex account and a Plex Media Server: sign in with SIGN IN, below

settings.label: Sign In
settings.description:
Opens Plex to sign in: a code to enter at plex.tv/link, then a profile and a server
Signed in, the profile in use

settings.label: Current User
settings.description:
The Plex Home profile Plex plays as
A profile with a PIN asks for it the next time Plex opens

settings.label: Auto Sign In
settings.description:
Whether Plex asks who is watching as it opens
[ON] Opens as the profile chosen last, without Select User
[OFF] Select User every time

settings.label: Server
settings.description: The server Plex browses and plays from, of those the profile can use

settings.label: Libraries
settings.description: Which of the server's libraries the home screen lists

settings.label: Video Quality
settings.description:
The most a video is sent at
[DIRECT PLAY] The file as it is, no transcode
[1080P] Transcoded where larger, at 8 Mbps at most
[720P] Transcoded where larger, at 4 Mbps at most
[480P] Transcoded where larger, at 2 Mbps at most

settings.label: Resume Playback
settings.description:
Where a video stopped part-way starts again
[ASK] Asks: from where it stopped, or from the beginning
[ALWAYS] From where it stopped
[NEVER] From the beginning

settings.label: Autoplay Next Episode
settings.description:
What follows an episode played to its end
[ON] The next episode of the series
[OFF] Back to its page

settings.label: Scaling
settings.description:
How a 16:9 picture fills the 4:3 screen in this module
[DEFAULT] As Settings' Scaling says

settings.label: Sign Out
settings.description: Signs out of Plex on this device, which plex.tv is asked to forget
